affordances.name: CesiumMan Character
affordances.semantic: Animated character model that can be selected, walks to car, and performs celebration

affordances.name: Ferrari Car
affordances.semantic: Drivable sports car that player enters and controls

affordances.name: Speed Gates
affordances.semantic: Five colored ring gates placed along runway that must be driven through

affordances.name: Target Zone
affordances.semantic: Marked area on ground where car must stop after drift

affordances.name: HUD Display
affordances.semantic: On-screen interface showing step, speed, and progress

affordances.name: Keyboard Controls
affordances.semantic: E key to enter car, Space to start engine, WASD to drive

states.name: Initial Setup
states.description: Scene loaded with CesiumMan standing beside parked Ferrari, awaiting player interaction

states.name: CesiumMan Selected
states.description: Player has clicked CesiumMan, character is highlighted and ready to enter car

states.name: Driving Active
states.description: Player is in car with engine started, driving through speed gates
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.playerInCar === true && window.__3D_STATE__.engineStarted === true && window.__3D_STATE__.gatesPassed < 5

states.name: Gates Completed
states.description: All 5 speed gates have been passed, drift maneuver available

states.name: Challenge Complete
states.description: Car stopped at target, CesiumMan exited and celebrating with looping animation
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.cesiumManExited === true && window.__3D_STATE__.celebrationPlaying === true && window.__3D_STATE__.stoppedAtTarget === true

states.name: Stable End State
states.description: Challenge completed and system stable for extended period

action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = rect.left + rect.width / 2; const y = rect.top + rect.height / 2; canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true }));

document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'e', code: 'KeyE', bubbles: true })); setTimeout(() => { document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: ' ', code: 'Space', bubbles: true })); }, 2000);

postconditions: CesiumMan entered car and engine started

action.code: const driveSequence = () => { document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'w', code: 'KeyW', bubbles: true })); setTimeout(() => document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { key: 'w', code: 'KeyW', bubbles: true })), 800); }; for(let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { setTimeout(driveSequence, i * 1000); }

postconditions: Car is accelerating and moving forward

action.code: const passGates = () => { for(let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { setTimeout(() => { document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'w', code: 'KeyW', bubbles: true })); setTimeout(() => document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { key: 'w', code: 'KeyW', bubbles: true })), 600); }, i * 800); } }; passGates();

postconditions: All 5 speed gates have been passed
